crossRefs.note: I thank you, and praise you, you God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me…
Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said…

translations.web: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.
translations.bsb: This was the dream; now we will tell the king its interpretation.
translations.kjv: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
translations.asv: This is the dream; and we will tell the interpretation thereof before the king.
